AiSearch.description_en: This topic describes the method to invoke the multi-stage streaming API V3 for general search by using the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI SDK, including parameter descriptions
AiSearch.description_zh: 本文介绍通过阿里云OpenAPI SDK调用通用搜索多阶段流式接口V3的方法以及参数说明

CommonQueryByScene.description_en: Performs a natural language general-purpose query

GenericAdvancedSearch.description_en: This topic describes how to invoke the enhanced search operation (GenericAdvancedSearch) by using the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI SDK, including the method and metric description. Compared with GenericSearch, GenericAdvancedSearch provides better recall of authoritative websites, with a maximum recall count of 40, delivering improved authoritativeness and data diversity. The response parameters and format of the enhanced operation are consistent with those of GenericAdvancedSearch
GenericAdvancedSearch.description_zh: 本文介绍通过阿里云OpenAPI SDK调用通用增强搜索接口（GenericAdvancedSearch）的方法以及参数说明。GenericAdvancedSearch相较于GenericSearch提供了更好的权威站点的召回，召回数量最大可以达到40条，可以提供更好的权威性与多样性数据。增强版接口返回参数字段与格式与GenericAdvancedSearch一致

GetIqsUsage.description_en: Queries the daily usage of the information query service API
GetIqsUsage.description_zh: 信息查询服务接口日维度使用量查询

GlobalSearch.description_en: IQS Search - Global Edition (Global Information Search)
GlobalSearch.description_zh: 通晓搜索-出海版(全球信息搜索)

MedicalKnowledge.description_en: Queries the knowledge graph of health information

OmniAnswer.description_en: This topic describes the SearchStream API operation for AI chat with streaming output. Based on retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and large language model technologies, this operation accepts natural language questions from users and automatically performs intention recognition, query rewrite, multi-source retrieve, and content generation. The operation returns data by using the Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming protocol, and supports real-time output of inference status, reference sources, and token-by-token generated answers. This operation is suitable for AI chat and search scenarios that require low latency and high explainability
OmniAnswer.description_zh: 本文档介绍智能搜索问答流式接口（SearchStream）。该接口基于检索增强生成（RAG）与大语言模型技术，接收用户自然语言问题后，自动执行意图识别、查询改写、多源检索与内容生成。接口采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 流式协议返回数据，支持实时输出推理状态、参考来源及逐字生成的答案，适用于对低延迟、高可解释性有要求的智能问答与搜索场景

ReadPageBasic.description_en: Quickly fetches HTML and parses static web page content
ReadPageBasic.description_zh: 快速获取 HTML 并解析静态网页内容

ReadPageScrape.description_en:
Reads HTML and parses web page content through a browser sandbox environment.
The operation begins parsing after the target page resources are fully loaded (you can adjust the maximum wait time through the pageTimeout parameter). The overall response time is significantly affected by the resource loading status of the target site
ReadPageScrape.description_zh:
通过浏览器沙箱环境读取 HTML 并解析网页内容。
接口将在目标页面资源完全加载后开始解析（可通过 pageTimeout 参数调整最大等待时长），接口整体耗时将显著受目标站点资源加载情况的影响

ScanFile.description_en: Scans document images (such as exam papers, books, official documents, certificates, and line drawings) and converts them into scanned copies by using the latest AI technology. This operation provides powerful image processing capabilities that effectively remove noise and correct image distortion, achieving high-definition scanning effects that can replace traditional scanners with photos
ScanFile.description_zh: 扫描文件接口利用最新的AI技术，将文档图片（例如试卷、书籍、公文、证件、线稿等）转换为扫描件。接口具有强大的图像处理能力，能够有效去除噪声、矫正图片的形变，能够实现拍照替代传统扫描仪的高清扫描效果

UnifiedSearch.description_en: Provides access to the Tongxiao unified search API, enabling quick and easy integration of web-wide general search capabilities
UnifiedSearch.description_zh: 通晓统一搜索API，简单快捷的接入全网通用搜索能力
